instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a full, eye-level shot captures an indoor motion capture studio with a dark red carpeted floor, white walls, and red partitions. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left, facing right with a neutral expression. The man in the black cap and blue shorts (R1) stands on the right, leaning forward and placing his right hand on her left shoulder. There are no bystanders in the room. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
